description: Drought Response and Recovery Project for Water Utilities in Tuolumne Utilities District, CA is a case study listed in U.S. Climate Resilience Toolkit, a national climate-adaptation toolkit, published or maintained by EPA, U.S. Environmental Protection Agency. The U.S. Environmental Protection Agency’s storymap contains case studies and videos that describe the experiences of small and medium-sized drinking water utilities that successfully responded to drought. Explore the story of Tuolumne Utilities District, CA. Coverage: the United States (2022). The listed link gives the documented application. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the toolkit page (no licence or terms statement seen). Caveats: this record was written from the toolkit page, which was read; the cited source documents and the outcomes reported were not checked, and no model or dataset used was verified. It can support comparison with similar adaptation projects and planning precedents. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-us-climate-resilience-toolkit-catalogue.
